heroHeadline: M7.7 Earthquake Strikes Flores Island, Indonesia
heroSubtitle: Recovery entered its rebuilding phase this week: BNPB began constructing 2,029 temporary shelters in East Manggarai, handing over the first unit in Kampung Bugis on 17 September, while confirming residents may also self-build to spec for reimbursement. The same day, BNPB and the Ministry of Health clarified that the 94 deaths classified as 'indirect' within the 142-person toll mostly involved evacuees dying of chronic-disease complications rather than earthquake trauma. Manggarai Regency separately extended its own emergency status through 28 September, even as the province had already declared recovery underway on 12 September, and NTT convened a Kupang forum to reconcile three diverging casualty and damage datasets ahead of finalizing its Rp2.59 trillion rehabilitation-reconstruction plan.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
